comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
community.enter: Dis a {community} — big up di place!
community.enter.half-way-tree: Half Way Tree! Heart of uptown Kingston!
HWT! Everybody pass through Half Way Tree!
community.enter.linstead: Linstead Market! Carry mi ackee go a Linstead Market!
Yuh reach Linstead — nuh badda speed through di market!
community.enter.bog-walk: Bog Walk Gorge — beautiful road, mind di corners!
Di gorge beautiful, enuh! Easy round di bends!
community.enter.faiths-pen: Faith's Pen! Stop and get some jerk chicken, nuh?
Dem jerk chicken at Faith's Pen? Best pon di island!
community.enter.fern-gully: Fern Gully! Look how pretty di gully green!
Welcome to Fern Gully — di most beautiful road in Jamaica!
community.enter.ocho-rios: Ocho Rios! Yuh reach! Dunn's River a call yuh!
Ochi! Di tourist dem a wait fi yuh!
dog.chase: Dog deh pon yuh! Drive drive drive!
Lawd a mercy, di dawg a chase yuh!
Town dawg nuh easy — step pon it!
goat.hit: Yuh lick di goat! Look wah yuh do!
Brethren, dat a somebody goat yuh lick deh!
Di goat! Di goat! Lawd have mercy!
goat.nearMiss: Nearly lick di goat — mind where yuh a drive!
Eh-eh, di goat cross right in front a yuh!
